sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    i.N_AIH,
    i.MORTE
  FROM internacao i
  WHERE i.DT_INTER >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND i.DT_INTER <  DATE '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN b.MORTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
    2
  ) AS taxa_mortalidade_hospitalar_percent,
  COUNT(*) AS admissions,
  SUM(CASE WHEN b.MORTE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS deaths
FROM base b
answer: A taxa de mortalidade hospitalar em 2025 foi de 4,25% (583.819 óbitos em 13.733.489 internações).

sql:

  h.CNES AS cnes_hospital,
  h.NO_HOSPITAL AS hospital,
  COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE i.MORTE = TRUE) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS taxa_mortalidade_hospitalar_pct
FROM internacao AS i
JOIN hospital AS h
  ON i.CNES = h.CNES
WHERE i.DT_INTER >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND i.DT_INTER < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY h.CNES, h.NO_HOSPITAL
ORDER BY taxa_mortalidade_hospitalar_pct DESC, hospital ASC, cnes_hospital ASC
answer: O resultado apresenta taxas por hospital, não uma taxa única geral. Entre as linhas exibidas, a maior foi 67,86% no Hospital Mont Serrat; o resultado foi truncado.

sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    s.SEXO AS sex,
    s.DESCRICAO AS sex_descricao,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.N_AIH) AS admissions
  FROM internacao i
  JOIN sexo s
    ON i.SEXO = s.SEXO
  WHERE i.DT_INTER >= DATE '2024-01-01'
    AND i.DT_INTER <  DATE '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY s.SEXO, s.DESCRICAO
), total AS (
  SELECT SUM(admissions) AS total_admissions
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  b.sex,
  b.sex_descricao AS sex_descricao,
  b.admissions,
  ROUND(b.admissions * 100.0 / t.total_admissions, 2) AS percentual
FROM base b
CROSS JOIN total t
ORDER BY b.admissions DESC, b.sex ASC
answer: Em 2024, as internações foram 56,7% Feminino (7.958.979) e 43,3% Masculino (6.076.853).

sql:
WITH internacoes_por_dia AS (
    SELECT
        isodow(i.DT_INTER) AS dia_numero,
        COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes
    FROM internacao AS i
    INNER JOIN municipios AS m
        ON i.MUNIC_RES = m.CO_MUNICIPIO_6D
    WHERE m.SG_UF = 'RS'
    GROUP BY isodow(i.DT_INTER)
)
SELECT
    CASE dia_numero
        WHEN 1 THEN 'segunda-feira'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'terca-feira'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'quarta-feira'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'quinta-feira'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'sexta-feira'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'sabado'
        WHEN 7 THEN 'domingo'
    END AS dia_semana,
    total_internacoes
FROM internacoes_por_dia
ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC, dia_numero ASC

sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    c.DS_CAPITULO AS diagnosis_chapter,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.N_AIH) AS admissions
  FROM internacao i
  JOIN cid c
    ON i.DIAG_PRINC = c.CID
  WHERE i.DT_INTER >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND i.DT_INTER <  DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY c.DS_CAPITULO
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    diagnosis_chapter,
    admissions,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY admissions DESC, diagnosis_chapter ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  diagnosis_chapter,
  admissions
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY admissions DESC, diagnosis_chapter ASC
answer: Em 2025, os 3 capítulos da CID com mais internações foram: XV. Gravidez, parto e puerpério (2.064.896), XIX. Lesões, envenenamento e outras consequências de causas externas (1.548.718) e XI. Doenças do aparelho digestivo (1.455.219). Total somado nas 3 categorias: 5.068.833.

sql:
WITH cid_completo AS (
    SELECT c."CID" AS cid_codigo, c."DS_CAPITULO" AS capitulo
    FROM cid AS c
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cm."CID" AS cid_codigo, cm."DS_CAPITULO" AS capitulo
    FROM cid_manuais AS cm
)
SELECT
    cc.capitulo AS capitulo_cid,
    COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes
FROM internacao AS i
JOIN cid_completo AS cc
    ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = cc.cid_codigo
WHERE i."DT_INTER" >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND i."DT_INTER" < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND cc.capitulo IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY cc.capitulo
ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC, capitulo_cid ASC
LIMIT 3
answer: Os três capítulos da CID com mais internações em 2025 foram: XV. Gravidez, parto e puerpério (2.064.896), XIX. Lesões, envenenamento e outras consequências de causas externas (1.548.718) e XI. Doenças do aparelho digestivo (1.455.219).

WHERE i.DT_INTER >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND i.DT_INTER <  DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND m_res.NO_MUNICIPIO = 'Canoas'
  AND m_hosp.NO_MUNICIPIO = 'Porto Alegre'
  AND m_hosp.SG_UF = 'RS'
answer: Em 2025, foram atendidas 2.584 internações de residentes de Canoas em hospitais de Porto Alegre.

sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    s.SEXO AS sex,
    s.DESCRICAO AS sex_descricao,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.N_AIH) AS admissions
  FROM internacao i
  JOIN sexo s
    ON i.SEXO = s.SEXO
  WHERE i.DT_INTER >= DATE '2024-01-01'
    AND i.DT_INTER <  DATE '2025-01-01'
  GROUP BY s.SEXO, s.DESCRICAO
)
SELECT
  sex,
  sex_descricao AS sex_label,
  admissions,
  ROUND(admissions * 100.0 / SUM(admissions) OVER (), 2) AS percentual
FROM base
ORDER BY admissions DESC, sex ASC
answer: Em 2024, as internações se distribuíram assim: Feminino 7.958.979 (56,7%) e Masculino 6.076.853 (43,3%).

sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    isodow(i.DT_INTER) AS weekday,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.N_AIH) AS admissions
  FROM internacao i
  LEFT JOIN municipios m
    ON i.MUNIC_RES = m.CO_MUNICIPIO_6D
  WHERE m.SG_UF = 'RS'

  admissions
FROM base

answer: O dia da semana com mais internações de residentes do Rio Grande do Sul é a segunda-feira (weekday=1), com 2.405.057 internações. Em seguida vêm terça (2.278.339), quarta (2.242.348), quinta (2.157.967), sexta (1.976.408), sábado (1.226.324) e domingo (1.191.594).

sql:
WITH internacoes_rs AS (
    SELECT
        i.N_AIH,
        isodow(i.DT_INTER) AS dia_semana_numero
    FROM internacao AS i
    JOIN municipios AS m
      ON i.MUNIC_RES = m.CO_MUNICIPIO_6D
    WHERE m.SG_UF = 'RS'
), contagem_por_dia AS (
    SELECT
        dia_semana_numero,
        COUNT(DISTINCT N_AIH) AS total_internacoes
    FROM internacoes_rs
    GROUP BY dia_semana_numero
)
SELECT
    CASE dia_semana_numero
        WHEN 1 THEN 'segunda-feira'
        WHEN 2 THEN 'terca-feira'
        WHEN 3 THEN 'quarta-feira'
        WHEN 4 THEN 'quinta-feira'
        WHEN 5 THEN 'sexta-feira'
        WHEN 6 THEN 'sabado'
        WHEN 7 THEN 'domingo'
    END AS dia_semana,
    total_internacoes
FROM contagem_por_dia
ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC, dia_semana ASC
answer: Segunda-feira é o dia com mais internações de residentes do Rio Grande do Sul, com 2.405.057 internações.

sql:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT
    c.DS_CAPITULO AS diagnosis_chapter,
    COUNT(DISTINCT i.N_AIH) AS admissions
  FROM internacao i
  JOIN cid c
    ON i.DIAG_PRINC = c.CID
  WHERE i.DT_INTER >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND i.DT_INTER <  DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY c.DS_CAPITULO
), ranked AS (
  SELECT
    diagnosis_chapter,
    admissions,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY admissions DESC, diagnosis_chapter ASC
    ) AS rn
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  diagnosis_chapter,
  admissions
FROM ranked
WHERE rn <= 3
ORDER BY admissions DESC, diagnosis_chapter ASC
answer: Em 2025, os 3 capítulos da CID com mais internações foram: XV. Gravidez, parto e puerpério (2.064.896), XIX. Lesões, envenenamento e outras consequências de causas externas (1.548.718) e XI. Doenças do aparelho digestivo (1.455.219).

sql:
WITH cid_completo AS (
    SELECT c."CID" AS cid, c."DS_CAPITULO" AS ds_capitulo
    FROM cid AS c
    UNION ALL
    SELECT cm."CID" AS cid, cm."DS_CAPITULO" AS ds_capitulo
    FROM cid_manuais AS cm
), capitulos AS (
    SELECT
        cc.ds_capitulo AS capitulo_cid,
        COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes
    FROM internacao AS i
    JOIN cid_completo AS cc
        ON i."DIAG_PRINC" = cc.cid
    WHERE i."DT_INTER" >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND i."DT_INTER" < DATE '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY cc.ds_capitulo
)
SELECT capitulo_cid, total_internacoes
FROM capitulos
ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC, capitulo_cid ASC
LIMIT 3
answer: Os três capítulos da CID com mais internações em 2025 foram: XV. Gravidez, parto e puerpério (2.064.896); XIX. Lesões, envenenamento e outras consequências de causas externas (1.548.718); e XI. Doenças do aparelho digestivo (1.455.219). As contagens representam internações/AIHs, não pacientes únicos.
